title: Charley Parker on Casein
content: Charley Parker of the blog "Lines and Colors" has written a well-illustrated and comprehensivepost on painting in casein, as well as areviewof my recent video "Casein Painting in the Wild.""Casein is one of the least familiar of the water based painting mediums available to contemporary painters, even though it’s one of the oldest painting mediums known. Casein’s use can be reliably traced back over 9,000 years, with evidence of the formulation in cave paintings, and examples have been found in ancient Egyptian tombs from several thousand years ago....Personally, I find casein to be a genuine pleasure to work with. I like the way it flows and handles, the textural possibilities and the appealing color and matte surface in finished paintings."Painting with Casein PaintReview of "Casein Painting in the Wild" on Lines and Colors
